sections.headline: One product. One clear summer story.
sections.copy: Lead with an image-led proposition, then keep the essential message and action in accessible live text.

sections.headline: A scannable proof layer
items: Use three to five distinct benefits rather than repeating the headline.
Keep product and result statements factual and source-backed.
Make the primary product recognisable even when the email is scanned quickly.
Retain useful live text when images are blocked.

sections.headline: How to build the educational chapter
sections.intro: Follow the product story with concise guidance that earns attention and helps the reader act confidently.

steps.title: Prepare
steps.copy: Set the context and state the first practical action.

steps.title: Apply
steps.copy: Explain the core technique in one readable instruction.

steps.title: Develop
steps.copy: Add timing or care guidance only when it is verified.

steps.title: Finish
steps.copy: Explain what completes the routine or result.

steps.title: Maintain
steps.copy: Close with simple aftercare or the next useful step.

sections.headline: Bridge education into merchandising
sections.copy: Use one editorial image and a short transition before presenting complimentary products or bundles.
